SELECT dm.MODEL_ID, dm.MODEL_CODE, dm.MODEL_NAME, dm.MODEL_TYPE, CASE dm.MODEL_TYPE WHEN 'FINANCIAL' THEN '财务模型' WHEN 'RISK' THEN '风险模型' WHEN 'AUDIT' THEN '审计模型' ELSE dm.MODEL_TYPE END AS MODEL_TYPE_NAME, dm.BUSINESS_MEANING, dm.DATA_SOURCE_ID, ds.SOURCE_NAME AS DATA_SOURCE_NAME, dm.VERSION, dm.STATUS, CASE dm.STATUS WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN '草稿' WHEN 'PUBLISHED' THEN '已发布' WHEN 'ARCHIVED' THEN '已归档' ELSE dm.STATUS END AS STATUS_NAME, dm.IS_ENABLED, dm.EXECUTION_COUNT, dm.LAST_EXECUTION_TIME, dm.CREATE_USER, dm.CREATE_TIME, dm.UPDATE_TIME FROM TBL_DATA_MODEL dm LEFT JOIN TBL_DATA_SOURCE ds ON dm.DATA_SOURCE_ID = ds.SOURCE_ID
dm.STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND dm.IS_ENABLED = 'Y'
AND ( dm.MODEL_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR dm.MODEL_CODE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR dm.BUSINESS_MEANING LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND dm.MODEL_TYPE = #{modelType}
ORDER BY dm.EXECUTION_COUNT DESC, dm.LAST_EXECUTION_TIME DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_DATA_MODEL ( MODEL_ID, MODEL_CODE, MODEL_NAME, MODEL_TYPE, BUSINESS_MEANING, CALCULATION_LOGIC, DATA_SOURCE_ID, SQL_STATEMENT, WITH_CLAUSE, SELECT_CLAUSE, FROM_CLAUSE, WHERE_CLAUSE, GROUP_BY_CLAUSE, HAVING_CLAUSE, ORDER_BY_CLAUSE, DRAG_CONFIG, THRESHOLD_CONFIG, WARNING_CONFIG, TEMPLATE_ID, PARAMETER_CONFIG, TEMPLATE_TYPE, VERSION, STATUS, IS_ENABLED, EXECUTION_COUNT, LAST_EXECUTION_TIME, EXECUTION_RESULT, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{modelId}, #{modelCode}, #{modelName}, #{modelType}, #{businessMeaning}, #{calculationLogic}, #{dataSourceId}, #{sqlStatement}, #{withClause}, #{selectClause}, #{fromClause}, #{whereClause}, #{groupByClause}, #{havingClause}, #{orderByClause}, #{dragConfig}, #{thresholdConfig}, #{warningConfig}, #{templateId}, #{parameterConfig}, #{templateType}, #{version}, #{status}, #{isEnabled}, #{executionCount}, #{lastExecutionTime}, #{executionResult}, #{createUser}, #{createTime}, #{updateUser}, #{updateTime} )
